milestones.title: Break It on a Branch
milestones.joke: A pull request that should not merge.
milestones.when: forgejo: a `drop-costcenter` pull request is opened in the student's fork

milestones.title: The Gate Holds
milestones.joke: The pipeline said no before the cloud had to.
milestones.when: verify: a **Policy check** (`pr.yml`) run for a pull request on the fork failed (checked after the pull request is opened)

milestones.title: Fixed and Merged
milestones.when: forgejo: the `drop-costcenter` pull request is merged

milestones.title: Main Applied
milestones.joke: Code in, cloud changed, nobody typed apply.
milestones.when: verify: the newest finished **Apply** (`main.yml`) run on the fork is green (checked after the merge)
